hook.text: Here's how to fully turn off Apple Intelligence.

problem.text: macOS 27 removed the single switch, and keeps about 12 GB of AI models on your disk.

name.text: RemoveMacAI fixes it, with over 3,700 GitHub stars in nine days.

features.text: It switches off Siri, Genmoji and ChatGPT, plus analytics and ads. You review every change first.

catch.text: The catch: Apple silicon and macOS 27 only. But it's free, open source, and you can undo everything.

cta.text: Would you turn it off? Comment MAC and I'll pin the link.

sources: GitHub API 2026-10-08: omlahore/RemoveMacAI 3,732 stars, 100 forks, MIT, created 2026-09-29

README read 2026-10-08: turns off Siri, Writing Tools, Genmoji, Image Playground, ChatGPT, summaries; models deleted and blocked from downloading again; nothing changes until you click Apply; every change can be undone; Apple silicon, macOS 27 only
The Verge 2026-10-05 (Stevie Bonifield): the single Apple Intelligence toggle was removed in macOS 27; models stay on disk; developer says about 12 GB
Official demo docs/terminal.gif: 'Models on disk 12.2 GB' ... 'Done. Apple Intelligence is off and 12.2 GB is free.'
Also covered by Ars Technica, The Register, MacRumors, AppleInsider (README press list)
